description: Create a capital-instrument request — the rule PAYS the buyer from the seller's margin (stored in seller's table). You must be one of the two. bid/ask computed from who creates first. Not a loan.

buyer.description: The account the rule pays (the investor). Set this to yourself to bid to buy.

seller.description: The account that issues the rule and pays it from its margin — the rule is stored in this account's table (the firm). Set this to yourself to offer/sell.

factor.description: The rate: 0.10 = 10% of the period's net income each close.

price.description: Capital in — the total the buyer pays for the instrument.

cap.description: Optional LIFETIME payout ceiling — the deal stops once cumulative distributions reach it (e.g. 550000). Omit for a perpetuity.

product.description: The marketplace name for the instrument. Default net_income_percent_dividend (a capped net-income share).

thread.description: Optional existing negotiation thread to counter against; omit to open a new one.
